links.comparator_used: Dermatologist melanoma risk assessment before exposure to ADAE scores (clinician alone, no AI)
links.outcome: Dermatologist diagnostic discrimination for melanoma (AUC); net benefit of biopsy decisions
links.effect: AUC 0.7798 before vs 0.8161 after ADAE exposure, p = 0.042; post-ADAE decisions had equivalent or higher net benefit than biopsying all lesions
links.quote: The dermatologists' ability to assess melanoma risk significantly improved after ADAE exposure (AUC 0.7798 vs. 0.8161, p = 0.042).

design_hint: clinician review with AI score exposure; prespecified sensitivity threshold selection
